title.en: When Things Go Wrong on a Trip

scenario.title: 旅行中生病、差點錯過班機、後悔
scenario.context: 旅行出包後，最常說的就是「早知道就…」：早知道就買保險、早知道就不吃那家路邊攤。英文用 should have + p.p. 表達後悔，shouldn't have + p.p. 表達「不該做卻做了」。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: How are you feeling? You look terrible.
lines.zh: 你感覺怎樣？你看起來好糟。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I'm sick as a dog. I shouldn't have eaten that seafood at the beach.
lines.zh: 我病得很慘。我不該吃海邊那家海鮮的。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I told you it had been sitting in the sun all day.
lines.zh: 我就說那些東西在太陽底下曬一整天了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I know, I know. I should have listened to you.
lines.zh: 我知道我知道，我應該聽你的。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: No. I should have, but I thought it was a waste of money.
lines.zh: 沒有。我應該買的，但我以為那是浪費錢。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Let's go to a clinic. You're totally out of it.
lines.zh: 我們去診所吧，你整個人都恍神了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Much better. I'm definitely on the mend.
lines.zh: 好多了，我肯定在恢復中。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Good, because we almost missed our train this morning. You should have set an alarm!
lines.zh: 很好，因為我們今天早上差點錯過火車。你應該設鬧鐘的！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I did set one. I just slept through it.
lines.zh: 我有設，只是睡死了沒聽到。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Well, we made it with two minutes to spare. That was a close call.
lines.zh: 嗯，我們在最後兩分鐘趕上了，好險。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Next trip, I'm doing everything right. Insurance, alarms, no beach seafood.
lines.zh: 下次旅行我一定全部做對：買保險、設鬧鐘、不吃海邊海鮮。

patterns.en: I think I have food poisoning.
I need to see a doctor.
We made it just in time.

chinglish.wrong: If I know, I will buy insurance.
chinglish.right: I should have bought insurance. / If I'd known, I would have bought insurance.
chinglish.why: 「早知道就…」是對過去的後悔，要用 should have + p.p. 或第三類條件句（第 64 單元）。
should 後面接原形，表示過去要用 have + p.p.。

chinglish.wrong: I eat bad food, my stomach is broken.
chinglish.right: I ate something bad. My stomach is really upset.
chinglish.why: 過去的事用過去式；肚子不舒服是 upset stomach，不是 broken。
almost 放在動詞前面，不放句首。

grammar.title: should have + p.p. 表後悔
grammar.oneLiner: should have + p.p. = 當時應該做（但沒做）；shouldn't have + p.p. = 當時不該做（但做了）。
whenToUse: 後悔沒做：I should have bought insurance.
後悔做了：I shouldn't have eaten that.
批評或責怪別人：You should have told me.
口語縮寫：should've（聽起來像 should of，但寫法是 have）。
相關：could have + p.p.（本來可以但沒有）：We could have taken the earlier train.
相關：would have + p.p.（本來會）：I would have come, but I was sick.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文「早知道就…」「應該要…的」後面接的動詞不用變，時間靠語境。英文的 should 是情態動詞，後面只能接原形，所以要表示「過去」就得加 have + p.p.，這和第 46 單元的 must have 是同一個邏輯。台灣人常說 I should bought 或 I should buy，後者會被聽成「我現在應該買」。

examples.correct: I should have checked the weather.
We shouldn't have stayed out so late.
We could have taken a taxi, but we walked.
I should buy insurance for my next trip.
examples.note: 注意：沒有 have 就是講現在或未來。

quiz.question: I missed the flight. I ___ earlier.
My stomach hurts. I ___ so much street food.
You should ___ told me you were sick!
We ___ taken the earlier train, but we wanted to sleep in.
I should have ___ (bring) a jacket. It's freezing.

slang.usage: 誇張地形容生病，特別是嘔吐、發燒。

examples.en: I was sick as a dog all weekend.
examples.zh: 我整個週末都病得很慘。

examples.en: Half the team is sick as a dog with the flu.
examples.zh: 團隊一半的人得流感病得很重。

slang.usage: 因為累、生病、吃藥而反應遲鈍。

examples.en: Sorry, I'm a bit out of it. I didn't sleep last night.
examples.zh: 抱歉我有點恍神，昨晚沒睡。

examples.en: The medicine made me totally out of it.
examples.zh: 那個藥讓我整個人昏昏沉沉。

slang.usage: 病情好轉中，也可以用在關係或經濟恢復。

risk.note: 溫和好用，寫卡片也適合。

examples.en: Grandma had surgery last week, but she's on the mend.
examples.zh: 阿嬤上週動了手術，但正在康復。

examples.en: Good to hear you're on the mend!

slang.usage: 差點發生壞事。That was a close call!

examples.en: We almost missed the last bus. That was a close call!
examples.zh: 我們差點錯過末班車，好險！

examples.en: The scooter almost hit me. Close call.
examples.zh: 那台機車差點撞到我，好險。

review.question: The clinic visit cost ___ I expected.
review.explanation: 複習第 48 單元：twice as much as。

review.question: ___ sick, I stayed in bed all day.
review.explanation: 複習第 47 單元：分詞構句表原因。

review.question: If I ___ you, I'd see a doctor right away.
review.explanation: 複習第 45 單元：If I were you。

review.question: Our flight took ___ two hours late.
This is the ___ I've felt in years.
You look pale. You ___ get some rest.
review.explanation: 複習第 17 單元：should + 原形。

review.question: I ___ in a hostel this week, but I usually stay in hotels.
review.explanation: 複習第 1 單元：暫時狀態用進行式。

review.question: Which is correct?
options: I should have bought a ticket.
